title: BNPL Plan Comparator
description: Side-by-side BNPL plan cost comparison on Reg Z Appendix J APR maths, with every APR computed by art-215 compute_reg_z_appendix_j_apr (imported and delegated to, never reimplemented). Enter a USD principal plus up to 8 plans: a provider preset (labelled examples quoted from dated primary-text snapshots of PayPal, Klarna, Afterpay and Affirm US consumer pages, never an offer) or explicit parameters (instalment count, cadence weekly/biweekly/monthly, stated APR, upfront and per-instalment fees, optional quoted instalment amount). Each plan returns its payment schedule, total of payments, fee total, finance charge and the Reg Z APR of the stream, and the comparison ranks plans by total cost. Terms vary by provider, merchant and credit decision.

input_schema.description: principal (USD) plus 1 to 8 plans; each plan is either {preset} or explicit instalment parameters.

principal.description: Purchase amount in USD to split across each plan.

currency.description: Currency; only USD is supported (US consumer terms).

plans.description: Plans to compare; preset entries inherit a provider's published plan shape.

items.description: One plan: either a preset id or explicit parameters, never both.

label.description: Caller's own display label for the plan.

preset.description: Snapshot-backed preset id (labelled example, not an offer).

apr_pct.description: Stated APR in percent as quoted (0 for interest-free).

upfront_fee.description: One-time fee paid at purchase, USD.

per_instalment_fee.description: Fee added to every instalment, USD.

instalment_amount.description: Quoted instalment amount; required when apr_pct is above 0.

down_payment.description: Down payment made at purchase, USD.

first_instalment_at_purchase.description: True when the first instalment is due at purchase (pay-in-N style).

mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare BNPL plans side by side on Reg Z Appendix J APR maths (delegated to art-215): schedules, fees, finance charges and computed APRs for pay-in-N and monthly plans, provider presets as cited labelled examples (never an offer), ranked by total cost.

output_schema.description: output_payload: input echo, comparison (ranking by total of payments, lowest-total plan indices), per-plan schedule (kind, instalment_no, due_periods_from_purchase, amount), totals, fee total, finance charge, stated APR, reg_z_apr (apr_pct null with flags when no rate is bracketed; computed by art-215), preset provenance (clauses, lender, late-fee note, qualifiers, not-an-offer status), method and terms notes; refusals return domain_error by name.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface. Plan-shape preset values come verbatim from the four primary-text snapshots (PayPal P1, Klarna K1/K2, Afterpay A1/A2, Affirm F1/F2, fetch 2026-10-28, research/clause-snapshots/bnpl-*-2026-10/SNAPSHOT.md); the APR is computed by the imported art-215 Reg Z Appendix J solver, never restated here.

output_example.apr_method: Every APR is computed by art-215 compute_reg_z_appendix_j_apr (Reg Z Appendix J general actuarial equation, bracketed bisection), imported and delegated to, never reimplemented.
output_example.terms_note: Presets are labelled examples from dated provider snapshots, never an offer. Terms vary by provider, merchant and credit decision; provider quotes carry their own qualifiers.
output_example.late_fee_note: Late fees are contingent on missed payments and are not part of any schedule here; preset entries cite each provider's stated late-fee clause as information only.
